heading: How to Apply
intro: Enrolling at ISA is straightforward. Follow the steps below and complete the enquiry form — our admissions team will contact you within 24 hours.

steps.title: Submit an Enquiry
steps.desc: Fill in the enquiry form with your child's details and desired entry level. Our team will reach out to schedule a meeting.

steps.title: School Visit & Assessment
steps.desc: Attend a guided tour and entrance assessment appropriate to your child's age and level.

steps.title: Offer Letter & Acceptance
steps.desc: Receive an admission offer. Review, sign, and confirm acceptance with the required documents.

steps.title: Fee Payment & Enrolment
steps.desc: Complete fee payment and receive your child's student ID, uniform details, and resumption date.
